sinopsis.es: Una anciana campesina lucha por preservar el linaje de su última gallina ante su desaparición; para ello recurre a su ingenio y diferentes medios de incubación de los últimos huevos que le quedan.
sinopsis.en: An elderly peasant woman struggles to preserve the lineage of her last hen as it faces extinction; to do so, she draws on her ingenuity and uses various methods to incubate the last few eggs she has left. An elderly woman and her animals, holding on together, because in the small, everyday things, life always finds a way to go on.
